description:
## Site
apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/interactive_test.exs has three
near-identical ~20-line helpers added across opi-tze.2, .5, .8:

  defp start_coder_session_for_steer! do ...
  defp start_coder_session_for_dequeue! do ...
  defp start_coder_session_for_escape! do ...

They differ only in the tmpdir suffix string. Each spins up:
- a faux %OctoPi.AI.Model{},
- a tmp SessionStore,
- a SessionManager,
- an Agent loop,
- a Coder loop wired to all three.

## Change
Promote to a single module-level helper:

\`\`\`elixir
defp start_coder_session!(tag) do
  ...
end
\`\`\`

The \`tag\` only affects the tmpdir name (debug aid). Existing
opi-tze tests retain their current describe-level identity by
threading the tag through.

## Tests
No behavior change; all existing tests should keep passing.

## Why this isn't done in opi-tze
Surfaced during post-review. Each ticket added one helper for its
own tests; the consolidation pass needs all three on disk to do
cleanly.
title: DRY the start_coder_session_for_*! helpers in interactive_test.exs
